credibility.line: Operational growth is strong, but management pushes back project timelines and experiences cash flow conversion drag.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue growth accelerated to 57.9% YoY in Sep 2026 reaching ₹1,691 cr, supporting management expansion claims.
Management reported record FY26 PAT of ₹755 cr, but FCF turned negative to -₹63 cr due to high capex.
Borrowings increased from ₹605 cr in Mar 2024 to ₹1,160 cr in Sep 2026, raising D/E from 0.08 to 0.23.
EBITDA margins expanded from 10.0% in Mar 2023 to 19.0% in Sep 2026, keeping long-term profitability strong.

bull: Revenue YoY growth surged from 3.8% in Dec 2025 to 57.9% in Sep 2026 reaching ₹1,691 cr.
EBITDA margins expanded 1,100 bps over three years to 19.0% in Sep 2026.
PAT grew 31.2% YoY to ₹231 cr in Sep 2026, building on FY26 PAT of ₹755 cr.
bear: Free cash flow fell to -₹63 cr in FY26 while OCF/PAT ratio deteriorated to 0.51.
Total borrowings nearly doubled from ₹605 cr in FY24 to ₹1,160 cr in Sep 2026.
Anthraquinone and carbazole project completion was delayed from Q2 FY27 to Q4 FY27.
